name: Henry Rose
bioAdditions: Husband of Mary Meier. FamilySearch: born 1861 at Essen, Germany; immigrated 1881/82; married at Hazleton in 1885; died at Hazleton on 19 May 1927 (S1). Their daughter Josephine's 1920 Luzerne marriage docket (No. 91450) names her parents as Henry Rose and Mary (née Meyers), both born in Germany (S2).
